taskPacket.objective: Close two residuals the first contract left open: the unfiltered document `rec play` prints off a terminal, and the `.?' that turns a too-long config path into a panic in `rec transcribe --refine`.
instructions: Read the 'Not fixed here' section of docs/campaigns/rec-audit-remediation/REMEDIATION.md first: it names both items, with file and line.

Item 1 - `rec play` prints an unfiltered document. In src/playback.zig's non-interactive branch (around lines 110-122), `markdown.render` output is written straight through `printStderr`, so a transcript containing ANSI/OSC bytes reaches a terminal. src/markdown.zig fixed its own `show()` path with the private `filterForPipe`, which you cannot call from playback.zig. src/viewport.zig already exports `stripControls(text, keep, buf)`; use it with `"\n\t"` as the keep set, over a buffer the size of the rendered document, before the write. Extract the filtering into a small helper in src/playback.zig so it is directly testable, and name the test exactly `playback non-interactive document is filtered`. Do not touch the interactive (tty) path, and do not add a second copy of the filter.

Item 2 - src/transcribecmd.zig around line 333 still has `llm.templatesDirPath(config_dir, &tpl_buf).?`. The first contract made `templatesDirPath`/`joinPath` return null when the result would not fit the caller's buffer, so a pathologically long `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`/`HOME` now panics at that `.?` instead of overflowing the buffer. Handle the null the way the neighbouring failures in the same function do: print `refine: ignorado (sem diretório de templates)` through `ui.print` and return, leaving the transcript untouched. Do not edit src/llm.zig - it is not in your writeFiles and its contract already returns an optional.

taskPacket.objective: Stop the unit suite from leaving rec-wav-test artifacts in the repository, delete the ones already committed, and give FINDING-SYNTH-17 a real mode assertion.
instructions: Context: `wav.testPath` (src/wav.zig, around line 317) builds `{s}/rec-wav-test-{pid}{suffix}` with `testDir() orelse "."`, and `testDir()` returns null unless `TMPDIR` (POSIX) or `TEMP`/`TMP` (Windows) is exported. Under `zig build test` from a shell without `TMPDIR` every test artifact lands in the repository root, and because the controller seals and commits the whole attempt worktree, 14 of those paths are now committed in this branch (`rec-wav-test-*.cfg/deepgram_key`, `rec-wav-test-*.auth/sample.wav`). This is the defect you are fixing - it was found by the operator, not by the audit.

Fix the root cause so no test artifact can ever land in a tracked path: make the POSIX fallback an always-present scratch directory (the system temp directory) rather than `.`, keep the Windows `TEMP`/`TMP` lookup, and keep the returned shape `rec-wav-test-<pid><suffix>` so existing tests need no change. Update the doc comment above the function to state the guarantee. If a test path is still not creatable on some platform, that must fail the test loudly rather than silently writing next to the source.

Delete every committed artifact: list them with `git ls-files | grep '^rec-wav-test-'` and remove each path (and now-empty directory) from the worktree. These deletions are expected and in scope even though they sit outside `writeRoots`; state the count in your summary. Do not delete anything else.

Do NOT edit .gitignore or any other ignore file. The controller refuses a worker that changes the repository's ignore sources (`snapshot_ignore_changed`: 'workspace ignore sources changed during worker execution'), because that changes what the workspace snapshot is able to see. The root-cause fix plus the deletions closed this defect once already in a rejected attempt; the ignore pattern is neither needed nor allowed.

FINDING-SYNTH-17 verification gap: `openNew` opening 0o600 is asserted only indirectly today. Add a test named exactly `wav.openNew creates owner-only files` that creates a file through the same open path and asserts the resulting mode is 0600 (mask with 0o777; skip the assertion on Windows, where there is no POSIX mode).

Both verification entries declared in this packet must pass: the suite, then the check that no untracked rec-wav-test path exists afterwards. The second one only inspects untracked (`??`) entries, so the deletions you made are not counted against you.
